verdict.rationale: Sierra's voice product replaces IVR menus with a voice agent that understands customer context, uses memory, and resolves issues in real time. It can also take card and ACH payments over the phone, offers Voice Personas, and speaks 55+ languages. Its "build once and deploy across any channel — chat, phone, email, SMS" claim directly supports the same knowledge and actions as chat. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of voice performance, and in-depth technical docs on speech recognition and synthesis and on how chat-to-voice parity is configured.
